name: ContextLift
author: ContextLift

sections.description:
ContextLift is a powerful AI-powered internal linking plugin for WordPress that automates your SEO strategy by intelligently building contextual links across your website.

Unlike traditional SEO plugins that require manual setup, ContextLift learns your content structure and automatically improves your internal linking, helping search engines crawl and rank your content more effectively.

🚀 Why Choose ContextLift?

  • Automatically builds internal links across your site
  • AI-powered keyword extraction with 10 extraction strategies
  • Reduces click depth to improve crawlability
  • Eliminates orphan pages
  • Saves hours of manual SEO work

All core features are 100% free. Optional AI Plan adds Claude AI-powered features.

🔥 Key Features (All Free)

  • Smart Internal Linking: Automatically create contextual internal links based on keyword relationships.
  • Advanced Keyword Extraction: 10 extraction strategies including heading mining, content N-gram analysis, slug analysis, meta description mining, and image alt text mining.
  • Click Depth Analyzer: Identify pages that are too deep and improve site structure.
  • Heading Audit & Auto Fix: Detect missing or incorrect H1–H6 tags and fix them.
  • Keyword Mapping System: Assign and manage primary and secondary keywords for every post.
  • Bulk Internal Linking: Automatically link orphan pages in optimized batches.
  • Link Log & Revisions: Track and undo internal links with full control.
  • Scheduled Automation: Daily scans and weekly full site optimization using WP-Cron.
  • Anchor Diversification: Natural anchor profile with least-used keyword rotation.
  • Silo-Safe Linking: Category-aware bulk linking preserves content silos.
  • Anchor Text Audit: Detect keyword cannibalization, over-optimized anchors, and measure anchor diversity.
  • GSC Insights: Connect Google Search Console to find pages needing internal links based on real search data.
  • Feature Module Toggles: Enable/disable individual modules from a Rank Math-style settings dashboard.

🧠 AI Plan Features (Optional)

  • AI Keyword Suggestions: Claude AI analyzes your content and suggests optimal target keywords.
  • AI Link Suggestions: Semantic link opportunities beyond exact keyword matching.
  • AI Anchor Optimization: Natural, varied anchor text suggestions from AI.
  • AI Content Gap Analysis: Identify missing topics in your content strategy.
  • AI Content Generation: When no links exist, AI writes 2-3 natural sentences with internal links.
  • Editor AI Panel: AI suggestions directly in the Gutenberg editor sidebar.

AI features require an AI Plan license from contextlift.com.

📈 What You Can Achieve

  • Boost search rankings with better internal linking
  • Improve crawlability and indexing
  • Increase time on site with smart link placement
  • Strengthen topical authority
  • Scale SEO without extra effort

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

ContextLift API (contextlift.com) — Only when the AI Plan is activated. AI feature requests (keyword suggestions, link suggestions, content gap analysis) are sent to our server for processing via Claude AI. No data is sent without an active AI Plan license.

  • Service URL: https://contextlift.com/api/ai/
  • Privacy Policy: https://contextlift.com/privacy
  • Terms: https://contextlift.com/terms

Without an AI Plan, the plugin operates entirely locally with no external connections.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/contextlift directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open ContextLift from your dashboard.
  4. Click “Rebuild Context” to scan your content.
  5. Start automating your internal linking instantly.
  6. (Optional) Activate AI Plan from the “AI Features” tab for AI-powered suggestions.
sections.faq:
Does ContextLift slow down my website?

No. All heavy processing runs in the background via WP-Cron and admin-side execution. Your front-end remains fast.

Can I undo links created by the plugin?

Yes. You can manage and revert all links from the Link Log section.

Is this plugin really free?

Yes. All core features are completely free. The optional AI Plan adds AI-powered features via our server.

What does the AI Plan include?

AI-powered keyword suggestions, semantic link suggestions, anchor text optimization, content gap analysis, and AI content generation — all powered by Claude AI.

Does the AI Plan require a subscription?

No. It’s a one-time lifetime payment.
sections.changelog:
2.2.1

  • NEW: Anchor Text Audit — Detects keyword cannibalization when 2+ posts use the same anchor text pointing to different URLs
  • NEW: Over-Optimized Anchor Detection — Flags anchors used 5+ times to the same target page
  • NEW: Anchor Text Diversity Report — Visual bar chart of anchor distribution with Healthy/Over-used/Cannibalized status badges
  • NEW: Diversity Score (0-100) — Circular score ring measuring how well-distributed your anchor texts are
  • NEW: Google Search Console Integration — OAuth 2.0 connection to pull real search performance data
  • NEW: GSC Insights Dashboard — Priority pages table with Impressions, Clicks, CTR, Avg Position, and Internal Links count
  • NEW: Smart Status Badges — Pages classified as Needs Links / Underperforming / Healthy based on GSC data
  • NEW: Summary Widget — Zero-links pages count, Average CTR, and Quick Win opportunities (position 4-10)
  • NEW: Sortable & Filterable Table — Click column headers to sort, filter by status
  • NEW: 24-hour API Cache — Avoids GSC rate limits with Force Refresh option
  • NEW: Auto Token Refresh — Expired OAuth tokens automatically refreshed
  • IMPROVED: Tested up to WordPress 7.0

2.1.0

  • NEW: Feature Module Toggles — Rank Math-style card interface to enable/disable individual features
  • NEW: AI Content Generation — When no link suggestions exist, AI writes 2-3 natural sentences with internal links
  • NEW: AI Suggestions in Gutenberg Editor — AI Keywords and AI Links panels directly in the editor sidebar
  • NEW: Auto-fallback to AI when context-based suggestions are empty (Pro feature)
  • IMPROVED: Content Gap Analysis now shows formatted cards instead of raw JSON
  • IMPROVED: AI Link Suggestions include Insert Link buttons in both admin and editor
  • IMPROVED: Settings page redesigned with visual toggle cards and module descriptions
  • IMPROVED: Feature toggles saved via AJAX with instant visual feedback

2.0.0

  • NEW: AI Features tab with Claude AI-powered keyword suggestions
  • NEW: AI link suggestions with semantic understanding
  • NEW: AI content gap analysis
  • NEW: AI anchor text optimization
  • ENHANCED: 10 keyword extraction strategies (was 4)
  • NEW: Heading-based keyword extraction from H2/H3
  • NEW: Content N-gram TF analysis for frequent phrase detection
  • NEW: Slug-based keyword extraction
  • NEW: Meta description keyword mining (Rank Math / Yoast)
  • NEW: Image alt text keyword mining
  • IMPROVED: Max keyword variations increased to 6 per page
  • NEW: AI Plan license activation system

1.0

  • Initial release
  • AI internal linking automation
  • Click depth analyzer
  • Heading audit and auto fix
  • Keyword mapping system
  • Bulk linking and link log
  • Scheduled optimization
